A reference implementation of Doc-to-LoRA (D2L).
--- ## 🛠️ Installation ``` curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh ./install.sh ``` ## 🤗 Pre-Trained Models ``` uv run huggingface-cli login uv run huggingface-cli download SakanaAI/doc-to-lora --local-dir trained_d2l --include "*/" ``` ## 🚀 Python API Usage ```python # caveat: this interface only supports non-batched inputs # for batched inference please see `src/ctx_to_lora/modeling/hypernet.py` import torch from ctx_to_lora.model_loading import get_tokenizer from ctx_to_lora.modeling.hypernet import ModulatedPretrainedModel # model loading checkpoint_path = "trained_d2l/gemma_demo/checkpoint-80000/pytorch_model.bin" state_dict = torch.load(checkpoint_path, weights_only=False) model = ModulatedPretrainedModel.from_state_dict( state_dict, train=False, use_sequence_packing=False ) model.reset() tokenizer = get_tokenizer(model.base_model.name_or_path) # prepare data doc = open("data/sakana_wiki.txt", "r").read() chat = [{"role": "user", "content": "Tell me about Sakana AI."}] chat_ids = tokenizer.apply_chat_template( chat, add_special_tokens=False, return_attention_mask=False, add_generation_prompt=True, return_tensors="pt", ).to(model.device) # calls after internalization will be influenced by internalized info model.internalize(doc) outputs = model.generate(input_ids=chat_ids, max_new_tokens=512) print(tokenizer.decode(outputs[0])) # remove internalized info # model.reset() # without internalized info, the model will halucinate # outputs = model.generate(input_ids=chat_ids, max_new_tokens=512) # print(tokenizer.decode(outputs[0])) ``` ### 🎮 Interactive Demo ```bash uv run demo/app.py ```

 353:     def _to_lora_dict(
 354:         self, flat_loras: Float[Tensor, "bs n_layers n_modules r max_io_dim"]
 355:     ) -> dict[str, dict[str, Float[Tensor, "bs n_layers r _"]]]:
 356:         if self.target_modules is None:
 357:             return None
 358:         # list of [bs, n_layers, r, in_d_outim]
 359:         # and in_d_outim might vary across modules
 360:         loras = unpack(
 361:             flat_loras,
 362:             [[] for _ in range(len(self.target_modules))],
 363:             "bs n_layers * r max_io_dim",
 364:         )
 365: 
 366:         # dict of {module:
 367:         #   {A: [bs, n_layers, r, d_inim],
 368:         #    B: [bs, n_layers, r, d_outim]}}
 369:         lora_dict = dict()
 370:         for module, lora in zip(self.target_modules, loras):
 371:             A, B = unpack(
 372:                 lora[..., : self.d_in[module] + self.d_out[module]],
 373:                 [[self.d_in[module]], [self.d_out[module]]],
 374:                 "bs n_layers r *",
 375:             )
 376: 
 377:             # apparently doing A * self.scaler_A is slow due to broadcasting
 378:             A = torch.einsum("ijkl,ijkl->ijkl", A, self.scaler_A[module])
 379:             B = torch.einsum("ijkl,ijkl->ijkl", B, self.scaler_B[module])
 380: 
 381:             lora_dict[module] = dict(A=A, B=B)
 382: 
 383:         return lora_dict

 385:     def _to_layernorm_dict(
 386:         self, flat_layernorms: Float[Tensor, "bs n_layers n_modules hidden_size"]
 387:     ) -> dict[str, Float[Tensor, "bs n_layers hidden_size"]]:
 388:         if self.extra_modules is None:
 389:             return None
 390:         layernorms = unpack(
 391:             flat_layernorms,
 392:             [[] for _ in range(len(self.extra_modules))],
 393:             "bs n_layers * hidden_size",
 394:         )
 395:         return {k: v for k, v in zip(self.extra_modules, layernorms)}

 401:     def forward(
 402:         self,
 403:         features: Float[Tensor, "bs seq_len feature_dim"],
 404:         attn_mask: Integer[Tensor, "bs seq_len"] | None = None,
 405:         position_ids: Integer[Tensor, "bs seq_len"] | None = None,
 406:         n_ctx_chunks: Integer[Tensor, "n_ctx"] | None = None,
 407:     ):
 408:         # [bs, n_layers, n_total_modules, r, feature_dim]
 409:         with _autocast_ctx(features.device):
 410:             if self.aggregator.layer_to_layer and self.iterative_mode:
 411:                 # iterative inference
 412:                 # features: [bs num_layers seq_len feature_dim]
 413:                 bs, n_layers = features.shape[0:2]
 414:                 lora_emb = torch.empty(
 415:                     (bs, n_layers, self.num_modules, self.r, self.config.latent_size),
 416:                     device=features.device,
 417:                 )
 418:                 for i in range(n_layers):
 419:                     lora_emb[:, i], _ = self.aggregator(
 420:                         features[:, i], attn_mask, position_ids
 421:                     )
 422: 
 423:             else:
 424:                 # batched inference
 425:                 lora_emb, _ = self.aggregator(features, attn_mask, position_ids)
 426: 
 427:         # [bs, n_layers, n_modules, r, max_in_d_outim]
 428:         flat_loras = None
 429:         if self.target_modules:
 430:             lora_emb = self.layers(lora_emb)
 431:             norm = torch.norm(lora_emb, dim=-1, keepdim=True)
 432:             norm_lora_emb = lora_emb / norm
 433:             flat_loras = self.head(norm_lora_emb)
 434: 
 435:         flat_layernorms = None
 436: 
 437:         return flat_loras, flat_layernorms

 440:         self,

 442:         attn_mask: Integer[Tensor, "bs seq_len"] | None = None,
 443:         position_ids: Integer[Tensor, "bs seq_len"] | None = None,
 444:     ):
 445:         flat_loras, flat_layernorms = self.forward(features, attn_mask, position_ids)
